title: RoadState: A Domain-Prior-Enhanced Vision-Language System for Industrial-Grade Lane-Level Map Updating
abstract: arXiv:2611.10746v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Lane-level maps provide foundational structured road information for navigation, intelligent driving, and intelligent transportation systems. Understanding road-scene semantics from structural and contextual cues is essential for reliable lane-level map updating, yet remains challenging in production due to occlusions, ambiguous lane markings, temporary obstacles, and viewpoint changes, while downstream workflows require temporally consistent, physically valid, and auditable outputs rather than free-form descriptions. We present RoadState, a production-deployed vision-language system that transforms sequential road-scene observations into structured lane-level semantics for Baidu Maps' map-updating pipeline. translated_title: RoadState：一个面向工业级车道级地图更新的领域先验增强视觉语言系统
translated_abstract: 车道级地图为导航、智能驾驶和智能交通系统提供了基础性的结构化道路信息。从结构性线索和上下文线索中理解道路场景语义，对于可靠的车道级地图更新至关重要，但在实际生产中仍面临诸多挑战，例如遮挡、模糊的车道标线、临时障碍物以及视角变化；同时，下游工作流要求输出具备时间一致性、物理有效性且可审计，而非自由格式的描述。我们提出了RoadState，这是一个已实际部署于生产环境的视觉语言系统，能够将连续的道路场景观测转换为结构化的车道级语义，服务于百度地图的地图更新流水线。其核心模型RoadState-VLM将道路场景理解建模为自回归状态估计，基于先前的观测、先前的符号状态以及当前观测来预测当前的结构化道路状态。
tldr: 该论文提出了已在百度地图生产环境中部署的视觉语言系统RoadState，其核心模型RoadState-VLM将道路场景理解建模为自回归状态估计，把连续的道路观测转换为结构化、时间一致且可审计的车道级语义，实现工业级车道级地图的可靠更新。
en_tdlr: This paper presents RoadState, a production-deployed vision-language system whose core model RoadState-VLM formulates road-scene understanding as autoregressive state estimation, transforming sequential road observations into structured, temporally consistent, and auditable lane-level semantics for industrial-grade lane-level map updating.
